name: Clarity
description: Measures how clearly the summary conveys the main findings and conclusions of the original study without ambiguity or confusion.

name: Comprehensiveness
description: Assesses whether the summary includes all essential components of the study, such as background, methods, results, and conclusions, without omitting key information.
scale: 1 (Missing Key Information) to 5 (All Key Information Included)

name: Relevance
description: Evaluates the degree to which the summary focuses on the most important aspects of the original paper, avoiding extraneous details that do not contribute to understanding the main research findings.

name: Conciseness
description: Determines how well the summary conveys the necessary information in a succinct manner, avoiding unnecessary verbosity or overly complex language.

name: Scientific Accuracy
description: Measures the accuracy of the information presented in the summary compared to the original paper, including correct use of terminology and adherence to scientific principles.
